blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The national government’s debt service bill dropped in August as the absence of a massive bond maturity settlement made in the same month last year sharply reduced principal repayments. Latest data from the Bureau of the Treasury (BTr) showed that debt payments fell nearly 89 percent to P76.12 billion in August from P664.72 billion a year earlier. READ: PH external debt service up as principal payments climb This brought the eight-month tally to P1.442 trillion, down 6.4 percent from P1.54 trillion in the same period last year.
